name: Du Hang pagoda
kicker: Phúc Lâm pagoda in Hồ Nam
summary: Walk Phúc Lâm pagoda in Hồ Nam, Lê Chân, the hall called Dư Hàng. The Buddha hall is seven bays, and the bell tower is three storeys. The bell is inscribed Phúc Lâm tự chung. A fee and a gate hour are Check on arrival. This is not đình Hàng Kênh.
getThere: Hồ Nam, Lê Chân. Minutes from the opera are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The pagoda front, with Phúc Lâm tự on the beam

notice.title: Not đình Hàng Kênh
notice.body: The communal house with the boat floor and the dragon carving is Hàng Kênh. This pagoda is Phúc Lâm.

body: A stele is tied to the early Lê, 980–1009, and the Trúc Lâm line to Trần Nhân Tông. Memorial days are the 2nd of lunar month 11 for Trần Nhân Tông and the 3rd for Huyền Quang. It was ranked a historic relic in 1986. The 1926 memorial for Phan Chu Trinh happened here.
The front carries the name on the beam. The visit is the seven-bay hall and the three-storey bell tower. A distance from the opera, a fee, and a gate hour are Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The thousand-armed figure inside Dư Hàng pagoda
figures.alt: A thousand-armed figure seated in the hall at Du Hang pagoda, with fruit and flowers

gettingThere: The pagoda is in phường Hồ Nam, quận Lê Chân. Check the minutes from the opera square on arrival.

legs.heading: From the opera square
legs.body: The center is the base if you sleep there. Check the minutes on arrival.
